summary: Something work needs to get done: a role someone fills, an outside partner, a system or a place.
example: Data analyst (a role), analytics partner (an outside partner), handheld scanner (a system), cold store (a place).
definition: Something work needs to get done: a role someone fills, a unit of your organisation, an outside partner, a system, a place, or a board or committee that makes decisions. You choose it wherever it is needed, such as a project's resources, the owner of a goal, or a stakeholder. A resource is a role or a thing, never a named person. Money is not a resource; add it as a budget. The teams that do and own the work are teams, not resources.

/metadata/name.guide: The usual name of the role or thing in your organisation. Name the position, not the person in it. Check the list before adding a new one.

poor.why: A person. Name the role she fills, such as Operations lead.
Money is a budget, not a resource. Add it as a budget and name it on the project's funding.

poor.text: Depot supervisor at the north depot
poor.why: Name the role once, as Depot supervisor. Each project says where it needs one.
An activity, not a resource. Name the role that runs it instead, such as Training facilitator.
A region is a segment, which you compare numbers across. The resource here would be a role, such as Regional coordinator.

/spec/category.guide: What type of resource this is: a role, a unit of your organisation, an outside partner, a system, a place, a board or committee that makes decisions, or other. Use other only when none of these fit.

poor.why: Chosen for the Seasonal training budget. Money is not a resource; add it as a budget.
Chosen for the Transport contractor. A contracted haulier is outside the organisation, so it is an external party.
Chosen for the steering committee. A committee makes decisions, so it is a board or committee, not a unit.

/spec/description.guide: What the role does or what it is for, in one sentence. Describe the work, not the person doing it now.
good: Runs one depot day to day, including intake and the quality check.
The scanner used at intake to record a delivery against a member.
Contracted haulier moving produce between depots and retail partners.

poor.text: Ada, who has run the north depot since 2019.
poor.why: Describes a person, not the role. Say what the role does.
Too vague. Say what the role does or what it is for.
